title: Engineering Productivity and Intelligence | Faros

hero.headline: Stop tokenmaxxing. Start outcome maxxing.
hero.subhead: One view of token spend across every team, tool, and model — mapped to the work and outcomes it produced.

sections.heading: Problems we solve
sections.body: Run engineering faster with AI that knows how you design, implement, test, and ship product.

sections.heading: AI Engineering Report 2026: acceleration whiplash
sections.body: Throughput is up; bugs, incidents, and rework are rising faster. Two years of data from 22,000 developers across 4,000 teams.

sections.heading: The Path to AI Impact (how it works)
sections.body: Connect (any AI tool, any SDLC, in days), Learn (build a knowledge graph of how teams build/deliver), Deliver (context flows to devs and agents), Prove (continuous measurement shows ROI).

sections.heading: Our secret sauce: engineering context, applied everywhere
sections.body: Context applied in the code, in the transformation, in the boardroom, in the platform, in the planning. Boardroom framing: prove AI impact and make the case for 'smarter—not smaller—budgets.'

sections.heading: Why engineering leaders choose Faros
sections.body: Complete Context (a unified model of how you work), Real Solutions (gains, not relocated friction), Proven Impact (value not just spend), Enterprise-Grade.

sections.heading: Who partners with us (testimonials)
sections.body: Autodesk (Ben Cochran, VP Developer Enablement), Coursera (Mustafa Furniturewala, SVP Engineering), SmartBear (Vineeta Puranik, CTO), Vimeo (Rachna Kamath, Chief of Staff to the CTO).
